text.p: These are the leading stories in the Moroccan press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Morocco says willing to welcome 65 African immigrants who crossed territory to reach Spain.
- Prime Minister Filali says in telecommunications seminar "liberalising the sector will lead to reduction of tariffs and improvement of services".
- More damage to buildings and roads following rains.
- Police break up network forging credit cards and circulating fake dollars in Casablanca.
- Confederation of Moroccan Businesses fears that deal allowing French firm Lyonnaise des Eaux to run water and electricity network in Casablanca will lead to higher costs.
- Rains flood whole districts in Rabat, Casablanca, Mohammedia and northern city of Larache.
